answer: An agent’s receipts are forged into a trellis-woven proof at a wharf-bound smithy, where the smith’s unique hammer strikes leave uncopyable micro-briefs in the metal. Each fake must re-forge at a new wharf, costing 0.1g of rare-hammer alloy and 3.7ms of seismic-warp compensation—no bulk smithy can replicate the wharf’s wave-energy hammer forging.
